queries: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_average_laps FROM per_driver;

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(laps), ''), '\N') AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_driver_laps FROM per_driver;

WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(laps) <> '' AND TRIM(laps) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(avg_laps) AS average_driver_laps FROM per_driver
